description: The node's BGP instance: its AS number and router ID, how many equal paths it installs, its BFD timers and the networks it announces.

x-chalkos-rules.messageExpression: "the AS number stays " + string(oldSelf) + "; to change it, deliver the config without the BGP document, which ends the router's sessions, and then with the new AS number"

multiplier.description: BFD packets in a row a peer may miss before the router takes it for down and ends the session.

receiveMs.description: Shortest interval in milliseconds at which the router accepts BFD packets of the peers with `bfd`.

transmitMs.description: Shortest interval in milliseconds at which the router sends BFD packets.

gracefulRestart.description: Whether the router keeps a peer's routes while the peer restarts and asks its peers to keep its own.

asPathRelax.description: Whether paths through different neighbouring ASes count as equal when their AS paths are equally long, as for two leaves of a fabric.

ebgp.description: Equal paths from external peers the router installs for one prefix at most.

ibgp.description: Equal paths from internal peers the router installs for one prefix at most.

networks.description: Networks the router announces to its peers.

policy.description: RoutingPolicy whose terms set the announcement's attributes; null announces it as it is.

prefix.description: Address range the router announces while its table holds a route to it.

x-chalkos-rules.description: A network's policy is a RoutingPolicy document.
x-chalkos-rules.messageExpression: cel.bind(pols, (("router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1" in config && "RoutingPolicy" in config["router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"]) ? config["router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"].RoutingPolicy : {}), "a network names the RoutingPolicy " + self.filter(w, w.policy != null && !(w.policy in pols))[0].policy + ", which the config does not hold")
x-chalkos-rules.rule: cel.bind(pols, (("router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1" in config && "RoutingPolicy" in config["router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"]) ? config["router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"].RoutingPolicy : {}), self.all(w, w.policy == null || w.policy in pols))

routerID.description: Router ID, in IPv4 notation, which the router's peers know it by; give an IPv6-only router one too.
